description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Dark 2 with Stacking] based on element of entry damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Kain] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Kain
description.text: Increases [Lightning/Dark Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Dragoon abilities trigger 1 additional time, PHY attacks deal 30% more damage (max 5 turns), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Dragoon's Pride+
description.text: Six single ranged jump attacks (1.20 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Gungnir+
description.text: Four single ranged attacks (1.10 each), grants [100% Critical 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Attach Dark 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
